item.title: UConn Basketball to Honor Aaliyah Edwards Before Xavier Rematch
item.description: Undefeated UConn basketball will induct WNBA star Aaliyah Edwards into the Huskies of Honor tonight, before facing Xavier at Gampel Pavilion. The post UConn Basketball to Honor Aaliyah Edwards Before Xavier Rematch appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: LPGA Announces Ford as Official Vehicle Partner in Multi-Year Deal
item.description: The LPGA Tour added Ford Motor Company as its official vehicle partner, signing a multi-year deal featuring a player mentorship program. The post LPGA Announces Ford as Official Vehicle Partner in Multi-Year Deal appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: LPGA’s Nelly Korda Questions Decision to Separate Women’s TGL League
item.description: Nelly Korda spoke out against TMRW Sports' decision to create a women's TGL league, arguing for integrated competition and equal prize money. The post LPGA’s Nelly Korda Questions Decision to Separate Women’s TGL League appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: Winter Storm Gives Vanderbilt SEC Schedule Boost Against Ole Miss
item.description: Winter storms gifted No. 5 Vanderbilt an extra day of rest, as the once-unbeaten Commodores look to bounce back against No. 17 Ole Miss on Friday. The post Winter Storm Gives Vanderbilt SEC Schedule Boost Against Ole Miss appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: Gotham Falls 1-0 to Corinthians in FIFA W Champions Cup Semifinal Upset
item.description: 2025 NWSL champions Gotham fell short at Wednesday's FIFA W Champions Cup semifinal, losing 1-0 to Brazilian titans SC Corinthians. The post Gotham Falls 1-0 to Corinthians in FIFA W Champions Cup Semifinal Upset appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: FIFA Women’s Global Transfer Report Reveals Chelsea as Top 2025 Spender
item.description: The 2025 FIFA Global Transfer Report dropped on Wednesday, with women's clubs reaching record-high spending for top athletes last year. The post FIFA Women’s Global Transfer Report Reveals Chelsea as Top 2025 Spender appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: WNBA Expansion Team Portland Fire Drop Jersey Designs Ahead of 2026 Debut
